name: Water for injection

sources.citation: Hikma. Sterile Water for Injection, USP, 1000 mL single-dose container. DailyMed updated May 8, 2023; set b20a28b0-7dfa-42eb-9177-ec256d5a5ef7. Attributed US reference, not confirmation of every Philippine container or preservative specification.

FDA Philippines. Product registration fields retained in the website dataset; exact formulations and current status require verification against the approved product insert. Reviewed 25 November 2026.

draft_notes: Product-specific Philippine instructions remain to be verified. No unverified composition, preservative assumption or renal replacement regimen is assigned.

revision_log.change: Faithfully attributed regulatory safety summary or descriptive guideline/registry findings; no unsupported dose or personal physician review claimed.
revision_log.approved_by: Codex source verification under existing delegated workflow.

overview.class: Parenteral diluent; not a standalone IV hydration fluid
overview.mechanism: A vehicle for preparation of compatible parenteral medicines; unmodified water is hypotonic [[SWFI]].
uses: Aseptic preparation of compatible parenteral solutions, according to the exact product and additive instructions [[SWFI]].

usual_adult_dose.dose: Use the volume and route specified for the medicine and container; no standalone hydration rate is assigned [[SWFI]].

contraindications: The cited US sterile-water label contraindicates IV administration without additives because of hemolysis risk [[SWFI]].

serious: Infusion of unmodified water can cause hemolysis; hemoglobin-associated renal failure has been reported [[SWFI]].

monitoring: Inspect clarity and container integrity; verify additive compatibility and aseptic preparation [[SWFI]].

key_interactions.action: Follow the additive’s instructions; do not treat bacteriostatic water as an automatically equivalent product [[SWFI,PHREG]].

renal: Water for injection is not a ready-to-use IV replacement fluid. The registry’s IV/rehydration category is not an administration instruction; plain water must not be infused IV [[SWFI,PHREG]].

rows.design: Prescribing information for a single-dose sterile product.
rows.findings: The solution must be adjusted toward isotonicity; plain IV water is hemolytic.
rows.limitations: The cited 1000 mL container is not a universal instruction for small-volume Philippine ampoules.

rows.findings: The cached fields do not establish preservative content or equivalence to benzyl-alcohol-containing bacteriostatic water.
rows.limitations: Check the exact insert; no preservative-free claim is inferred for every product.
